title: XGIMI MoGo 3 Pro projector (model G0035, device altai, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 14 (SDK 34),
header:
XGIMI MoGo 3 Pro projector (model G0035, device altai, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 14 (SDK 34),
build UKNV.260707.001.15802496.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xgimi-mogo-3-pro/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xgimi-mogo-3-pro/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (HOME priority 2), with the setup wizard's
RecoveryActivity at priority 1, so setupwraith is listed below (see docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, Google TV).
Wireless debugging is the way in: pair, then `adb tcpip 5555`. It turns itself off whenever the projector
rejoins Wi-Fi. Already disabled from the factory: com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic.

Launcher notes (applied and verified on a real unit on 2026-10-19/20):
- Install with HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1, and put this in config.xml or a theme's config.json:
"live_tv_package": ""                    no tuner
"settings_key_keycodes": [83]            the gear button sends KEYCODE_NOTIFICATION
"app_keys": ["KEYCODE_F4:com.google.android.youtube.tv",
"KEYCODE_F9:com.netflix.ninja",
"KEYCODE_F8:com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom"]
"stock_home_redirect": "com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx"
XGIMI's xrmservice re-enables the disabled stock launcher on every one of its remote keys
(docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). app_keys takes YouTube (F4), Netflix (F9) and Prime Video (F8) away from it.
The programmable button (F5, mute by default), the profile button (F6, whose chooser lived in the stock
launcher) and power (F11) still revive it: stock_home_redirect sends its home screen back, and
re-applying this list disables it again.
- HDMI 1 opens through com.google.android.tv.inputplayer from the Inputs menu, so no input_action is needed
(unlike the Horizon S Pro).
- The default Backdrop screensaver (dreamx) is disabled below: point the screensaver at
com.android.dreams.basic/.Colors first, or it has nothing to show.
- Check who owns the saved Wi-Fi network before setupwraith is disabled (TROUBLESHOOTING, "drops off Wi-Fi for
good"): on this unit the network set up during first-run setup disappeared and had to be joined again.
- Screenshots from `screencap -p` start with a vendor log line ("Init wrapper sys mutex ..."): strip
everything before the PNG signature.

DO NOT DISABLE on this model (projector hardware, inputs, mirroring):
com.xgimi.autokst                    # auto keystone correction
com.xgimi.windowsystem               # keystone/window service
com.xgimi.tof                        # ToF autofocus
com.xgimi.misckey                    # remote keys, focus/keystone shortcuts
com.xgimi.uiconfiguration            # global key receiver, power listener
com.xgimi.xrmservice                 # global remote keys, picture/sound adaptation (re-enables the stock launcher, see above)
com.xgimi.xgimiservice               # core XGIMI system service
com.xgimi.autoinstall                # purpose unclear (PermissionRequestActivity only): kept
com.xgimi.overseas.xgimiatvbootwizard  # first-boot wizard
com.mediatek.tvinput                 # HDMI input service
com.mediatek.tv.service              # TV service, Netflix key receiver
com.google.android.tv.inputplayer    # HDMI passthrough player and input switcher
com.nbcast.wirelessscreen            # MagiCast: the screen-mirroring receiver ("Mogo3Pro" in a phone's list)
